name: Uber
summary: Limit background location tracking, revoke contacts access, and enable two-step verification.

settings.name: Location Permission
settings.impact: The 'Always' setting lets Uber sample your GPS continuously, even when you are asleep. 'While Using' restricts location collection to when the app is actively on screen or a trip is in progress.
settings.source: WeLiveSecurity (ESET): 'How Uber seems to know where you are – even with restricted location permissions'

settings.name: Contacts Permission
settings.impact: Uber uses contact list access to build a social graph. Your contacts' data is shared without their knowledge or consent. Revoking prevents Uber from uploading your address book.

settings.name: Two-Step Verification
settings.impact: Your Uber account is linked to payment methods and your home address. Account takeover can result in fraudulent rides charged to your card. 2FA prevents access even if your password is compromised.

settings.name: Connected Applications
settings.impact: Third-party apps connected via Uber's API can access your trip history, location data, and personal details on an ongoing basis.
settings.source: Uber Privacy Center; Uber Newsroom Privacy Settings

settings.name: Notifications Audit (geofence ads)
clickPath: Review and disable promotional notification types
settings.impact: Uber uses Apple's geofence notification feature to send location-based promotional messages at airports and venues. Disabling marketing notifications removes this ad delivery mechanism.
settings.source: WeLiveSecurity (ESET): 'How Uber seems to know where you are – even with restricted location permissions'
